focus_areas: Legibility and structural integrity of dial numbers
Physical plausibility of the hand-glass interaction
Mechanical coherence of the central pointer pivot
Consistency of specular highlights on the curved glass
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text_gibberish' artifact. In barometers, the precision of the scale is defining. If the numbers are melted or illegible, the alignment score should be penalized heavily despite the correct general shape. Also, scrutinize the hand: AI often fails at realistic skin texture and contact shadows. Check if the finger appears to float above or sink into the glass.
image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a vintage-style aneroid barometer mounted on a wooden wall. A human hand enters from the left, with the index finger pointing at or touching the glass face of the dial. The barometer has a brass-colored metal casing with decorative curves and a white dial face featuring black numerical markings (likely millibars) and weather condition text (e.g., 'STORMY', 'RAIN'). The background consists of vertical wooden planks.
